definitions.absolute_fixed_setting: Output minus ideal electrical-fraction law with SAME physical corner,reference,input/knob state. No zero/gain correction applied.
definitions.ideal_knob_law: (2a-1)*IN +5*(2x-1)+CV. a,x are electrical fractions, not shaft position or factory calibration.
definitions.paired_gain: [out(+5)-out(-5)]/10 at same other input,knobs,corner and constant errors. Cancels intercept only under stated invariance; not absolute fixedsetting precision or actual calibrated residual.
definitions.signed_attribution: CV slope; IN network/attenuation loading/atten ratio; manual network/reference initial/loading/inverter intercept. Products kept in explicit order. Attribution order stated; only totals and same-corner counterfactual differences are order-independent.

necessary_next_conditions.ceiling_scope: Necessary symmetric reference-error ceiling with all four listed corrections ideal and high network ratio;0.5mV reserved for ALL remaining terms. Algebraic requirement, not adopted envelope, calibration, achievable part claim or sufficient wholecell proof.

conditioned_output_load_cases.scope: Exact monotone output equation over same coherent resistor/reference extrema; A0/ro engineering assumptions, Vos/Ib/leakage zero here and explicitly allocated separately. Not an actual-condition bound.

required_missing_parameters.amplifier: Each of ten signed input offsets at same actual supply/common-mode/temp/load plus per-pin bias and source impedances; common Vos ceiling is one-at-a-time, not guaranteed achievable.
required_missing_parameters.input: External source Thevenin resistance and source error; ADG powered on-resistance/leakage at same rail/commonmode/temp;100k pulldown and10k sense tolerance plus actual follower bias.
required_missing_parameters.output: DC Aol and output resistance at actual +/-12V/commonmode/output/load; load-dependent offset/bias and shield/ground shifts; load report provides algebra and inverted ceilings.
required_missing_parameters.reference: Raw/reference-buffer initial error and reference-inverter error must be treated once via shown coefficient; actual effectiveCL/ESR and line/load/temp conditions remain required.
required_missing_parameters.return: Actual source-to-receiver ground voltage (or every shared edge resistance and signed actual downstream current), excluding duplicate edge-use counts.
required_missing_parameters.temperature_aging: Chosen operating deltaT and time, each offset drift/bias at temperature, resistor/pot tracking and reference drift/aging. No operating envelope adopted.
